name: Immigration enforcement
description: The relationship between state and local agencies and federal immigration enforcement.

questions.oppose_means: Favors keeping or further restricting the current state limits on cooperation.
questions.support_means: Favors expanding cooperation beyond current state limits (for example, honoring more federal detainer requests).
questions.text: Should state and local law enforcement in California be allowed to cooperate with federal immigration enforcement beyond what current state law permits?
questions.notes: Current limits come mainly from the California Values Act (SB 54, 2017), bill ref ca-2017-sb-54.

questions.oppose_means: Favors keeping or lowering the number of skilled-worker visas.
questions.support_means: Favors raising the number of skilled-worker visas.
questions.text: Should the number of employment-based visas for skilled workers, such as H-1B visas, be increased?

questions.oppose_means: Opposes abolishing ICE (may still favor reforms, limits or added oversight of immigration enforcement).
questions.support_means: Favors abolishing ICE (for example, eliminating the agency or transferring its functions elsewhere).
questions.text: Should Congress abolish U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE)?
